description:
AWM: TARANTO, ITALY, 1940-11. AERIAL VIEW SHOWING AFTERMATH OF ACTION AGAINST THE ITALIAN FLEET IN TARANTO HARBOUR.
NHHC: Italian BB LITTORIO of Littorio Class (1937-1948). Ship later renamed ITALIA. Photo 1940. November 12, 1940 Taranto attack. December 11, 1940 entered dock for repairs.
